description: This file is an implementation of an Android InputMethodService for an autofill keyboard, including inline suggestion handling, UI setup, and interaction logic.

classes.name: AutofillImeService
classes.description: Main implementation of the Android Autofill InputMethodService with inline suggestions support.

classes.name: SuggestionItem
classes.description: A data holder class for inline suggestion views and their pinned status.

methods.name: onCreateInputView
methods.description: Inflates and sets up the input view layout, initializes suggestion strip elements.

methods.name: onStartInput
methods.description: Prepares the decoder and resets keyboard state when input starts.

methods.name: onFinishInput
methods.description: Handles cleanup when input finishes.

methods.name: cancelPendingResponse
methods.description: Cancels any scheduled pending response processing.

methods.name: postPendingResponse
methods.description: Schedules processing of an inline suggestions response.

methods.name: cancelDelayedDeletion
methods.description: Cancels any scheduled delayed deletion of inline suggestions.

methods.name: scheduleDelayedDeletion
methods.description: Schedules a delayed task to clear inline suggestions to avoid flicker.

methods.name: clearInlineSuggestionStrip
methods.description: Clears the inline suggestion UI elements.

methods.name: onStartInputView
methods.description: Handles logic when input view starts.

methods.name: onFinishInputView
methods.description: Performs cleanup when input view finishes.

methods.name: onComputeInsets
methods.description: Overrides inset calculations for IME UI adjustments.

methods.name: onCreateInlineSuggestionsRequest
methods.description: Creates a request for inline suggestions with style configurations.

methods.name: toPixel
methods.description: Helper for converting dp units to pixels.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height dimension for inline suggestion presentation.

methods.name: onInlineSuggestionsResponse
methods.description: Handles incoming inline suggestions response and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: updateInlineSuggestionStrip
methods.description: Updates the UI strip with new inline suggestion views, managing pinned and scrollable suggestions.

methods.name: rescheduleShowcaseBgFgTransitions
methods.description: Reschedules background/foreground transition animations.

methods.name: rescheduleShowcaseUpDownTransitions
methods.description: Reschedules up/down transition animations.

methods.name: inflateThenShowSuggestions
methods.description: Inflates suggestion views asynchronously and updates the suggestion UI.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Entry point to process particular commands or data strings.
